disposition: Phase-locking phase vocoder feasibility blocker. The task requires a runnable source, exact assets, permitted scope, task geometry and matched evidence, then a minimal reference compared against the baseline phase vocoder at identical ratios. No exact licensed reference implementation, immutable revision, license text, pinned runtime, rights-cleared audio, matched baseline/result pair, or qualified rate evidence is present or reproducible in this worktree. The catalogued rate profile cannot be satisfied by a candidate with no runnable rate artifact or measured output.

exact_blockers.required_action: Measure mode/platform timing and resources, complete authorized listening or a labeled screen, then open a separate OFF-by-default intake with clean-install proof and independent exact-head review.
exact_blockers.statement: No mode/platform timing, resources, pacing, listening/labeled screen, provider intake, clean-install proof, or independent review exists.
